title: The fox and the goose eggs

plan.english: Mother, a fox stole the eggs from the goose's nest! Where did the fox go? It ran into a hole under the birch. It will come again in the evening. Put the geese into the house, and set the dog beside the nest. May the dog bite the fox! Then the geese will not tremble before the fox. And I shall watch the nest.

title: What he saw beyond the mountains

plan.english: Husband, you have come home unharmed! What did you see beyond the mountains? I saw the great sea, and men row boats bigger than houses on it. Were you a guest of that people? I was their guest; they gave me fish and salt. And I give you this shining stone from the sea. It is beautiful! You are dearer to me than stones.
